contexts.text: The Angels do indeed lead; but they only minister; for it is the Lord alone who rules man through the Angels and Spirits; and as it is done with the ministry of the Angels, it is said Let us... AC 300:end.
Celestial men are called the priests of Jehovah; spiritual ones, the ministers of God ().
Whoever would be great among you shall be your minister... as the Son of Man is not come that it may be ministered to Him, but that He may minister... ().
Those who ministered; the things by means of which the [things] were ministered; and also the places where the ministration was (were all representative).
The Lord uses the ministry of Angels by infilling them with the Divine...
Boy = one who ministers and administers...
(The Levites numbered up to fifty years of age) = the full or ultimate state of discharging the ministry.

The reason the Levites were taken to discharge the ministry from a son of thirty years, to fifty () was that by thirty were signified those who were to be initiated; thus, who could as yet exercise warfare but little, as understood in the spiritual sense.
When reformation by the ministry of truth has been finished.
The Regal itself and the Sacerdotal itself are holy, whatever be the quality of him who ministers...
The Holy in which were the priests when they were ministering.
With whom the Angels are present as ministers...
When good dominates... truths are nothing else than ministers and servants.
Attendants = those things which minister.
By Uzzah was represented that which ministers; thus truth; for this ministers to good.

(Joseph) ministered to him () = that the Scientific was appropriated to its own good; (for) to minister = to be of service in supplying that of which another is in need; here, to be appropriated, because it treats of the natural good to which the Scientific is to be appropriated. Moreover, to minister is predicated of scientifics; for by a minister, and by a servant, in the Word, is signified the Scientific or natural truth; because this is subordinate to good, as to its lord. Explained.

For good is lord, and truth is minister; and, when it is said of a lord that he set a minister over, or of good that it set truth over, in the internal sense it is not signified that it ceded the dominion to it, but that it applied itself.

Upon his two ministers the stewards () = from the sensuous things of the body of both kinds... The sensuous things of the body... relatively to the interior man, are ministers like stewards... for they minister to him. Explained.
In general, all exterior things are ministers relatively to interior ones...
This word, in the Original Language, signifies a minister, steward, chamberlain, eunuch. In the internal sense, by it is signified the natural man as to good and as to truth. Illustrated.

(Joseph) ministered to them () = that he instructed. To minister = to instruct. That to minister, here, is not to minister as a servant, is evident from the fact that Joseph was set over them; and therefore to minister, here, = to sub-minister the things which would conduce to their [welfare].
To be set over is predicated of the good of life; and to minister of the truth of doctrine.
Servants are said relatively to the Divine truth which is from the Lord; and ministers () relatively to the Divine good from Him.
The royalty is not only with the king himself, but also with his ministers, who administer in such things as he himself cannot...
The reason the Angels are His ministries, is that they may be in an active life... but still the ministries which they perform are not from them, but from influx from the Lord.
The ministries of that religiosity which is from falsity. Signified.
Girls = ministries. Explained.

Good can be insinuated into another by anyone in the Country; but not truth, except by those who are teaching ministers. If others (do it), heresies come forth, and the Church is disturbed and torn to pieces.
Moses His servant = the Lord as to the Divine truth proceeding from Him and ministering.
A servant = one who ministers; and therefore the Lord as to the Divine Human, when He was in the world, is called a servant... for He then ministered.
The will is the man himself; and the understanding is his minister.
Joshua his minister () = what is representative... because what is representative is of service and ministers. AC 9419:2, Explained.
When it is treating of the twofold ministry, which is of judgment, and of worship. (Continued. See Judge, To.)
To minister () = while in worship and evangelization. (For) to minister, when said of Aaron, by whom is represented the Lord, = worship and evangelization. Explained.
To minister the ministry of Jehovah ().
The Levites represented truths ministering to good; and Aaron, the good to which they ministered... For in truths there must be life from the Divine in order for them to minister to good.

Worship from the good of faith, or from the good of charity... was represented by the ministration of Aaron and his sons in the Tent of the Assembly... and worship from celestial good... was represented by the ministration of Aaron and his sons at the altar.
In approaching to the altar to minister () = worship from the good of love; (for these words) = to represent the Lord as to the good of love.

By ministrant goods and truths are meant the goods and truths which are in the natural or external man, which are called Knowledges and scientifics. Explained... There are also goods and truths ministrant to these again...
As the truth of faith ministers to the good of love... it is said of Aholiab that Jehovah gave him with Bezaleel, which is to serve him.
And his minister Joshua () Divine truth ministering... in the place of Moses.
The prefects, officers, and servants in one royal palace...
The queen-bee lays eggs; the rest minister to her.
The governments in the Heavens... differ according to the ministries which belong to each Society. HH 217.

Governors who are such do not dominate and command; but minister and serve; for to do good to others from the love of good is to serve; and to provide that it may be done, is to minister. Neither do they make themselves greater than the rest; but less... Nevertheless they have honour and glory... (which) they accept not for the sake of self, but for the sake of obedience... These things are what are meant by the Lord's words (in ; ).
An image of conjugial love... in order that they may be waited on in sickness and old age.
Hence it is that inaugurations into the ministry are made by the imposition of hands.
Man is only a... minister steward...
Concupiscences are its ministries and attendances, by means of which it governs the exterior things... But, as is the king, such are the ministers and attendants...
Put on the garments of political ministers... CL 354:2. TCR 663.
All are as servants and ministers of their lord...
If you want to be led by the Divine Providence, use prudence, as a servant and minister, who faithfully dispenses the goods of his lord.

The Lord says this () because by a servant, and a minister, is meant one who is of service and ministers by teaching; and, abstractedly from person, Divine truth, which was Himself. (Continued. See Servant.)

In Heaven, all are called servants of the Lord who are in His Spiritual Kingdom; but ministers, who are in His Celestial Kingdom. The reason is, that (the former) are in wisdom from Divine truth; and (the latter) are in love from Divine good; and good ministers; and truth is of service.
Those in wisdom from the Lord are called kings' sons, and kings; and those who are in love from Him are called ministers, and priests...

And charity and ministry () = the spiritual affection which is called charity, and its operation... The reason ministry = its operation, is that those are called ministers, in the Word, who operate the things which are of charity. A man a worshipper of God is now called a servant, now a minister; and a servant of God is he called who is in truths; and a minister of God, who is in goods. The reason is that truth is of service to good; and good ministers to truth... That he who is in good is called a minister. Illustrated.
We are Englishmen, and we have heard many things from our sacred ministry... Some of them have said, We are ministers of God, and we know.
Ministers of God, seduce not the flock.
When afterwards promoted to an honoured ministry, they think (only) about themselves and the world...
In the Heavens... there are ministries and priesthoods...

By Michael... is meant a ministry in Heaven. (This) ministry is with those who confirm from the Word that the Lord is the God of Heaven and earth... By Gabriel is meant the ministry with those who teach from the Word that Jehovah came into the world... Moreover, those who are in these ministries are named Michaels and Gabriels.
Those not in any order of the ministry. Treated of.
Concerning the ministers (of the Papists) there is the idea that they are full of the Lord...

His servants shall minister unto Him ()... By the servants of the Lord are signified those who are in truths from Him; and by the ministers, those who are in good from Him. Hence by the servants who shall minister unto Him are signified those who are in truths from good through the Word from the Lord, and do His commandments.
All clothed with the garment of the sacerdotal ministry.
In other rooms they talked the news about courts, ministries...
From the number of their courtiers, ministers, and retinue, and the magnificent vestments of these...
The dress of the prince and his ministers. Described.
Then the attendants took loaves... and gave to each guest...
The understanding is nothing else than the ministry and servitude of the will.
In Heaven there are administrations, ministries, functions... Explained.

As the ecclesiastical order... ministers those things which are of the priesthood with the Lord, that is, which are of His love, and thus also the things which are of blessing, it is necessary that marriages be consecrated by His ministers; and, as they are also the heads of the witnesses, that the consent to the covenant be heard, accepted, confirmed, and thus established by them.
We fear only some of the ecclesiastical ministry...
Those ministers of the Church who are ambitious for a reputation of wisdom...
The Word from which the ministers proclaim a God...
The state of information by masters and ministers.
The state of every student who is being initiated into the ministry before he becomes a priest.
As if some minister of the Church were to teach... and beside him another minister stands, and murmurs into his ear...
Inauguration into the ministry carries these things with it.

It is the like with every minister of the Church; both with him who is in truths, and with him who is in falsities; each has his own mouth and his own intelligence; and each speaks from his own mind; that is, from his own spirit which he possesses.
Ministers, who are hypocrites... at the time when they are ministering holy things, and teaching truths from the Word, know no otherwise than that they believe them...
Who loves... any minister of the Church... except from his learning, integrity of life, and zeal for the salvation of souls?
By the debts of charity, are not here meant the debt of functions in a kingdom and republic; as of a minister that he should minister...
Like these are priests who perform the debts (or duties) of their ministry solely for the sake of the emoluments attached to them...
When I have consulted the ministers of the Church, I have heard that faith was the only means...
Besides, to a minister is given the opportunity to bless...
This free will is at this day denied by many ministers of the Church.
What, then, are Heaven and Hell, except fables of the ministers and prelates of the Church...
Religion... is to be taught by ministers both small and great...
It does no harm for anyone burdened in conscience to enumerate his sins before a minister of the Church, for the sake of absolution...
We have heard from our ministers, that the internal man is not anything but faith.
While the minister is preaching...

A comparison may be made with a minister of the Church: that he is estimated from his will and love, and at the same time from his understanding in spiritual things; and not from his affability and dress.
Their aiders are with them in that deepest...
They are of service as ministries for instructing others...
They employ the harmless as ministries...
As kings and their chief ministers openly write Falsities...
And ministry and faith () = good and truth there.

The reason ministry = good, is that ministry, in the Word, is said of good. Hence it is that the function of Aaron, of his sons, and of the Levites, has been called ministry; and, in general, [so has] the function of priests; and that by to minister to Jehovah or the Lord, is meant to worship Him from the good of love. Hence it is evident that, ministry has relation to works...
That ministry, and to minister, in the Word, are said of the good of love. Illustrated.
He shall make His ministers a flaming fire () = that they are recipients of the Divine good. Hence it is evident that by ministers are meant those who are in the good of love.
Ministers of His, doing His will ()... Ministers = those who are in goods.

Ye shall be called the priests of Jehovah, the ministers of our God (). The priests are called ministers, because they represented the Lord as to the good of love. Hence it is that those who are in the good of love, are called, in the Word, priests. From this also it is that they are called ministers of God. Hence it is that the function of Aaron and his sons is called ministry... and that to enter into the Tent of the Assembly and perform the ministry there, and also to approach the altar and perform the ministry there, is called ministry. Illustrated.
Of those who are in the Celestial Kingdom, to minister, is said... Hence it is evident what is signified by to minister, and a minister, in the following places. Illustrated.
As to minister is predicated of the good of love, it is said to minister to Jehovah... and therefore it is said of the Lord that He will minister.
(Thus) by ministry is signified all that is done from the good of love; thus the good of love.
The rams of Nebaioth shall minister to thee () = the truths which lead the life from spiritual affection.
To minister is predicated of good.
To minister = worship from spiritual good.
The Lord as to His Divine Human is called Servant and Minister. Illustrated. AE 409:4.
By ministers () are meant those who are in the Lord's Celestial Kingdom; and, as they are recipient of the Divine good, it is said that He makes them a flaming fire. AE 504:14.
That ministers are called ministers from the reception of Divine good. Reference.
Those who are in good are called in the Word the Lord's ministers; and [are said] to minister to Him.
With the Levites the priests My ministers () = conjunction with the Lord through Divine good.
The ministry of the Levites was called warfare. Explained.
The garments in which the Angels go clothed correspond to their ministries... Therefore Aaron and sons had garments of linen, in which they ministered. Illustrated.
The Divine good ministers all things through the Divine truth.
To be delivered by the judge to the minister...
The Babylonians persuade the people that... no others (understand the Word) who have not been inaugurated into the ministry.

In this kind of profanation are all who are in sacred ministries, and who, by means of the holy things of the Church, seek for themselves honour and glory, and rejoice at heart from these; and not from the use, which is the salvation of souls.
Which their ministers and monks teach.
(The Pope) has made his ministers deities.
The Vicar and his ministers...
By uses in the Heavens and on earth are meant ministries, etc.
In this love is everyone who is delighted with the use in which he is for the sake of use, whether king, magistrate, priest, minister...
4. The ministry (of the will and understanding).
4. In the Heavens, as in the world, all are in some function and ministration.
5. To bestow useful contributions and debts on the ministry of the Church (a general use).
From these is the common good... What is Divine is there by means of ministers...
That ministries, etc., are the goods of use which individuals perform, from which comes forth the common good. By ministries are meant priestly offices and their duties.
They who are in ministries perform [the use] that what is Divine is there.
Hence it follows that there is not any ministry, etc.
